_note: Endpoint manifest — generated from captured recordings of america.fun. One entry per API endpoint the cloned frontend calls. The route-implementer agent creates one src/routes/<name>.rs per entry; smoke tests each.

endpoints.name: platform_stats
endpoints.responseEnvelope: { success: bool, data: { totalTokensLaunched: u32, totalAolStaked: String, totalAolRewardClaimed: String, totalTreasuryFeeUsd: String, totalCreatorFeeUsd: String, totalVolumeUsd: String, volume24hUsd: String } }
endpoints.notes: Aggregate platform statistics

endpoints.name: aol_token_stats
endpoints.responseEnvelope: { success: bool, data: { currentPriceUsd: String, marketCapUsd: String, totalDexVolumeUsd: String, volume24hUsd: String } }
endpoints.notes: Platform native token (AOL) price and market data

endpoints.name: settings
endpoints.notes: Feature flags / site settings

endpoints.name: aol_staking_stats
endpoints.responseEnvelope: { success: bool, data: { totalStaked: String, totalRewardClaimed: String, totalStakingPower: String, rewardClaimed30d: String, newStake30d: String } }
endpoints.notes: Staking program aggregates

endpoints.name: fee_vault_history
endpoints.notes: Fee vault daily breakdown — time-series. Query params: granularity (day|hour), limit

endpoints.name: leaderboard
endpoints.responseEnvelope: { success: bool, leaderboard: { rank: u32, user_address: String, points: f64 }[] }
endpoints.notes: Points leaderboard — top 100 users by accumulated points

endpoints.name: tokens_system_list
endpoints.notes: System token list — large array of all tokens. Uses same Token shape as tokens/list

endpoints.name: volume_cumulative_daily
endpoints.responseEnvelope: { success: bool, data: { day: String, dailyVolumeUsd: String, cumulativeVolumeUsd: String }[] }
endpoints.notes: Full cumulative daily volume history — time-series

endpoints.name: token_market_ath
endpoints.responseEnvelope: { success: bool, data: { highestMarketCapUsd: f64, highestPriceUsd: f64, timestamp: u64 } }
endpoints.notes: All-time high for a specific token by mint address

endpoints.name: token_market_chart_peak
endpoints.notes: Chart peak close price for a specific token

endpoints.name: token_market_holders
endpoints.notes: Top holders for a specific token. Holder: { address, amount, uiAmount, decimals, uiAmountString, rank, percentage }

endpoints.name: token_market_trades
endpoints.notes: Recent trades for a specific token. TokenTrade: { txid, owner, side, amount, usdValue, timestamp, price }

endpoints.name: tokens_by_mints
endpoints.notes: Fetch token details by comma-separated mint addresses

endpoints.name: tokens_home_launches
endpoints.notes: Featured tokens for the homepage hero section

endpoints.name: tokens_list
endpoints.responseEnvelope: { success: bool, tokens: Token[], total: u32, limit: u32, offset: u32, sort: String, order: String, launchConfig: { configAddress: String, quoteMint: String } }
endpoints.notes: Paginated token list with sort/filter. Main data feed for the explore page

endpoints.name: staking_locked_metrics
endpoints.responseEnvelope: { aol_mint: String, total_locked_raw: String, total_supply_raw: String, decimals: u8, total_locked_tokens: f64, total_supply_tokens: f64, locked_percent: f64, source: String, staking_program_id: String, vault_accounts_found: u32, staking_vault_discriminator_hex: String }
endpoints.notes: On-chain staking lock status — simulated

endpoints.name: api_stream
endpoints.notes: Server-Sent Events stream for real-time token updates. Sends periodic token data events

endpoints.name: gateway_trades
endpoints.notes: Recent platform-wide trades across all tokens. GatewayTrade: { signature, instructionIndex, innerInstructionIndex, slot, blockTime, mint, pool, programType, trader, side, inMint, inAmount, inDecimals, outMint, outAmount, outDecimals, priceUsd, usdValue, feeAmount, feeMint }

endpoints.name: gateway_trades_stream
endpoints.notes: SSE stream of real-time trades across all tokens

endpoints.name: gateway_prices_stream
endpoints.notes: SSE stream of real-time price updates

endpoints.name: chart_jupiter
endpoints.notes: Proxied Jupiter chart data. Returns OHLCV candle arrays. Backend should generate synthetic candles from seed data

endpoints.name: jupiter_swap_quote
endpoints.responseEnvelope: { inputMint, inAmount, outputMint, outAmount, otherAmountThreshold, swapMode, slippageBps, priceImpactPct, routePlan, contextSlot, timeTaken, swapUsdValue, ... }
endpoints.notes: Proxied Jupiter swap quote. Backend returns simulated quote — never wires real signing
